page_title: BET 2-4 BAR | Betis v Barcelona 21/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+6' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Vitor Roque (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Joao Felix (Barcelona) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
90+4' Isco (Betis) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+2' 2 - 4 GOAL! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) runs onto a pass from Lamine Yamal after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 2:4.
90+2' Nabil Fekir flicks on the near post corner to Luiz Henrique (Betis) at the back post, but he somehow heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
90+1' Nabil Fekir (Betis) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.

90' 2 - 3 Goal! Great link up play between Joao Felix (Barcelona) and Ferran Torres gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 2:3.
89' Borja Iglesias (Betis) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
88' Luiz Henrique (Betis) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
87' Betis are ruled offside.

86' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jesus Gil Manzano blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Joao Felix (Barcelona) for Pau Cubarsi.
79' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
79' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
78' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.
76' Great solo effort from Luiz Henrique (Betis)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post.
76' The resulting corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) comes to nothing.
75' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Barcelona win a corner.
73' The free kick is delivered by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
73' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sergi Altimira (Betis) replacing Johnny.
72' Abner (Betis) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
71' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pedri.
71' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) misses a huge chance from inside the penalty area after unleashing a powerful first-time volley towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
69' Pedri passes to Ferran Torres (Barcelona), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
68' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
68' Marc Roca (Betis) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it.
67' Johnny (Betis) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
67' Luiz Henrique (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
66' Luiz Henrique (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
63' Substitution. Robert Lewandowski is replaced by Vitor Roque (Barcelona).
61' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Isco (Betis) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Luiz Henrique. The score is 2:2.
60' Attention! Referee Jesus Gil Manzano straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
59' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Isco (Betis) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
57' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
56' 1 - 2 What a hit! Isco (Betis) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top right corner. 1:2.

55' Abner (Betis) serves up a nice cross, but Inaki Pena punches the ball away. Inaki Pena stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Nabil Fekir (Betis) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom right corner.
54' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Isco (Betis), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
53' Nabil Fekir (Betis) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Betis.
53' The attendance for today's match is 53288.
52' Isco (Betis) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
51' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jesus Gil Manzano signals. Betis earn a free kick.
50' Borja Iglesias (Betis) tries to find Abner, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
48' 0 - 2 Goal! 0:2. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
48' OFF THE POST! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
46' Half-time substitution. Willian Jose (Betis) is replaced by Borja Iglesias.
46' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Nabil Fekir comes on the pitch for Assane Diao (Betis).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Jesus Gil Manzano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
45+2' Isco (Betis) trips an opposition player and Jesus Gil Manzano signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Barcelona.
45+2' The goal by Barcelona is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
45+1' Wait! Referee Jesus Gil Manzano immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
44' German Pezzella (Betis) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul. Barcelona are awarded a free kick.

41' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

38' OFF THE POST! Good play from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the left post! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal. The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ferran Torres (Barcelona) offside.
37' Isco (Betis) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of Inaki Pena.
36' A pass into the penalty area from Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence.
33' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Willian Jose (Betis) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
29' Abner (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Inaki Pena comes off his line to gather the ball.
29' 3:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
26' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
25' Luiz Henrique (Betis) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
23' One of the players from Betis times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Pedri puts the ball across the area and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 0:1.
18' Luiz Henrique finds Marc Roca (Betis) after some good work, but from the edge of the box he skews his attempted shot well wide of the right post.
17' Pedri (Barcelona) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
14' Pedri (Barcelona) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Frenkie de Jong, but the ball goes just over the bar.
11' Luiz Henrique (Betis) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
11' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) sends a long ball in, but Rui Silva comfortably gathers the ball.
9' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
8' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle after Assane Diao (Betis) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Barcelona will take a free kick near the side line.
6' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
6' Hector Bellerin (Betis) jumps into a tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano signals a foul. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
4' Isco plays a lovely pass into Luiz Henrique (Betis), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
3' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
3' Good defending. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) tries to find Jules Kounde inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
2' Luiz Henrique (Betis) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Barcelona win a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Barcelona will kick the game off.
Jesus Gil Manzano was nominated as the referee for this game.
